blocks.text: *The official guide to **Unwritten** — a 2.5D MMORPG where you hunt the blank pages of an unfinished world and write your own color into it.*

text: **Status:** Living wiki, in active development. Pages reflect the current design; anything marked *planned* or *in tuning* isn't final yet. Numbers and rosters are still being balanced before launch.

blocks.text: Long ago, someone wrote down the **truth of the world** — a record kept current as the world happened. Then the scribe was **silenced, mid-sentence**, and the record stops. Everything after that line was never written, and what is never written does not hold together: the blank pages that should have carried the rest scattered across the land and became **monsters**. With nobody keeping the record, people lost their identities — no name was ever inked — leaving them as **charcoal husks**.
You are one of those husks. You wander an endless world, hunting the blank pages and filling them in — and as you write, your **color arrives**. That gradual arrival of self *is* your progression.
The look of the game is the story: the flat, papery monsters **are** the blank pages; the 3D-but-colorless heroes **are** people no one ever wrote down.

items: **The World of Unwritten** — the setting, the Fourteen Unwritten, and why everything looks the way it does
**Getting Started** — your first steps as a husk *(work in progress)*
**World & Maps** — biomes and where the pages fell

**Skills** — actives, passives, and where they come from
**Combat Mechanics** — damage types, elements, and matchups

**The Sword** — how the first fully-authored weapon plays, and how its builds fit together
**Crafting & Recycling** — forge, fold, quench, write stats with Ink, and recycle
**Monsters** — every monster's numbers and where it lives
**Equipment** — every weapon and piece of armour, what it costs to forge, every trademark and every armour variant
**Materials** — every crafting material and every monster that drops it
**World Map** — every map, its view from above, and the monsters on it
**Elements** — the element chart at levels 1 to 4
**Roadmap** — one timeline of what has been built and what is coming next

blocks.text: *The Database pages are written by the game from its own data; every other page is authored from the game's design canon. Sections labeled "planned," "design intent," or "in tuning" are not final and will be updated as the design locks.*
